about: How the engine of this computer reads scanned pages (D-558, source_volume/recognition_local.rs): RapidOCR over ONNX Runtime, without a model in the cloud. `modelSet` is the set of models it reads with (the one the rapidocr package carries, downloaded by scripts/fetch-ocr-models.mjs); `longSidePx`, the longest side, in pixels, of the image of a page it reads (a larger one is scaled down: at 200 dots per inch without a limit the memory went past 11 GB). How sure the engine must be of a line for it to enter the text is not here (E1 of 2 nov): the base reads each page by zones, and each line takes its band (firm, approximate or discarded, D-668) with the thresholds of its configuration (D-722, Ajustes). The 0.9 that was here, measured with the answer sheets of printed passages and handwritten values (docbase/similar/check_local_reading.rs, 27 oct), is the low threshold by default.
